verdict.rationale: Modal docs describe sandboxes as isolated, scalable execution environments with snapshotting, filesystem, and networking support, and a community project (self-hosted GitHub Actions runners) demonstrates sandboxes being kept alive for extended, real workloads. However, no evidence pack item states explicit maximum session duration, timeout configuration, or guarantees for multi-day persistence, so long-running-session support is inferred rather than directly documented. Missing for 10: explicit docs on configurable/no timeout limits, guidance for multi-day sandbox lifecycles, and independent confirmation of hours/days-long sessions beyond one community anecdote.
